summary: Capital One Financial filed an 8-K on June 9, 2026, to file a prospectus supplement registering an additional 39,843 shares of common stock for resale by selling security holders. This brings total registered shares to 10,385,749, issued as consideration for the company's acquisition of Brex Inc., which closed on April 7, 2026. No price per share, premium, or advisor is specified in the filing. The shares are part of an automatic shelf registration statement on Form S-3. The filing updates the resale prospectus to allow selling holders to offer the stock. Watch for the resale activity and any impact from the underlying acquisition of Brex, a fintech firm, by Capital One.
